$schema_note: Generated from Uptime Kuma 2.5.8 sources: src/components/notifications/*.vue (fields), src/components/notifications/index.js (type ids), src/components/NotificationDialog.vue (labels, categories), server/notification-providers/*.js (server-side reads). See docs/kuma-api/notification-providers.md.

common_fields.name: name
common_fields.notes: Friendly name; also stored in notification.name column. Default 'My <Label> Alert (N)' (en.json defaultNotificationName).

common_fields.name: type
common_fields.notes: One of the keys of `types`. UI default 'telegram' for a new notification (NotificationDialog.vue:447-451).

common_fields.name: isDefault
common_fields.notes: Stored as is_default column AND inside config JSON; new monitors pre-select default notifications.

common_fields.name: applyExisting
common_fields.notes: One-shot: when true on save, the notification is attached to all existing monitors of the user; server resets it to false before persisting config (server/notification.js:286-288).

common_fields.name: active
common_fields.notes: DB column only (notification.active); not editable in the UI; returned in notificationList.

columns: config (JSON text of the whole notification object)

socket_events.testNotification: (notification, ack) -> {ok, msg}; sends `<name> Testing` with monitorJSON=null, heartbeatJSON=null
socket_events.notificationList: S->C [{id, name, active:boolean, user_id, is_default:0|1, config:'<json>', isDefault:boolean}]

variables.msg: the default message, e.g. '[Name] [🔴 Down] <heartbeat msg>'
variables.name: monitor name
variables.heartbeatJSON: Heartbeat.toJSONAsync({decodeResponse:true}) + timezone, timezoneOffset, localDateTime, lastDownTime (UP only), msg defaults 'N/A'; or null

options.label: Post to existing thread / forum post
Low Cost (Slow - sometimes blocked by operator)
SMS FLASH - Message will automatically show on recipient device. Limited only to Polish recipients.
SMS ECO - cheap but slow and often overloaded. Limited only to Polish recipients.
SMS FULL - Premium tier of SMS, You can use your Sender Name (You need to register name first). Reliable for alerts.
SMS SPEED - Highest priority in system. Very quick and reliable but costly (about twice of SMS FULL price).
APIv1 (for existing projects and backward compatibility)

fields.name: subscription
fields.notes: Set by the browser via PushManager.subscribe() with VAPID key from socket event getWebpushVapidPublicKey. Not usable from a native app without implementing Web Push.
